statement.detailedDescription: The issuing bank has received complaints from multiple cardholders about unauthorized charges from 'SLIMFIT WELLNESS'. This cardholder reports a $89.99 charge they did not authorize. The cardholder never visited this merchant's website or ordered any supplements. A pattern of unauthorized transactions from this merchant has been identified across several issuing banks.
statement.merchantResponseSummary: N/A — the cardholder has no knowledge of this merchant. Other cardholders report similar unauthorized charges.
statement.requestedResolution: Full reversal due to questionable merchant activity — pattern of unauthorized charges identified.
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this dispute statement is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Proceed with chargeback filing under Mastercard reason code 4849 (Questionable Merchant Activity).
